title: Vallee argues with Spielberg on Close Encounters set over time travel
place_text: Close Encounters of the Third Kind film set

tellings.quote: In fact, on the set of Close Encounters, he got into an argument with Steven Spielberg.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jacques Vallee, a well-known UFO researcher, got into an argument with film director Steven Spielberg on the set of Close Encounters of the Third Kind, Spielberg's 1977 film about meeting aliens. The story is framed around a disagreement over time travel, a hint that Vallee saw the phenomenon differently from the simple visitors-from-space picture in the film.
